text:
[Council File 26-1350]
Motion (Jurado – Nazarian) relative to creating a trust fund that provides emergency support for impacted Department of Water and Power customers by covering portions of their City utility services bills.
(This item is referred to the Energy and Environment Committee and Budget and Finance Committee.)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A council motion would create a trust fund to cover part of City utility bills for Department of Water and Power customers affected by the situation, as emergency support.

details.action: Create emergency bill-assistance trust fund for DWP customers

flag.reason: Utility bill support affecting DWP customers citywide.

outcome.text: Energy and Environment Committee approved item(s) (Oct 9, 2026)
